title: I made this board game with ChatGPT/Codex. This is very alpha. Please roast it.
author: ProfessionalPay1748
selftext: Since I’m out of ChatGPT credits and the refresh is for a week, might as well get ideas from you fellas. I’m really into board games stuff. Thought I’d try some ideas. I’m still iterating as much as I can for the gameplay.

comments.author: Left-Excitement3829
comments.body: Can you give us a brief on what the game is and what it does ?

replies.author: ProfessionalPay1748
replies.body: It’s supposed to be played with friends. Idea is 6 players cross the board to reach the portal and escape. But portal requires treasures to successfully leave. With some quirky dice mechanicsc, the play gets uncertain. Every failure in portal crossing generates consequences and hypes the board up. Or so that’s what I thought. LMAO. Maybe it’s plain bad or have little fun. 😂Please try if you can and let me know anything.

replies.body: Do you need 5 others or can you solo play
